purpose: Development-only hand annotation and successful Xcelium elaboration evidence for the OpenTitan Phase 0B scale comparison; automated tests do not load this file.

evidence_receipt.scope: Explicit repository-level Phase 0B synthesis across the original three Slang workloads, cc29 Xcelium/FSDB evidence, the Surelog comparison, and this OpenTitan scale workload.

slang_primary_frontend.scope: Primary for the prototype and synthesizable/core hierarchy; full OpenTitan UVM, bind, procedural-force, and simulator-extension semantics remain incomplete.

surelog_uhdm_comparison.reason: Slang's evidenced gaps triggered comparison, but pinned sc-surelog 1.84.1 segfaulted before producing a recovered top or UHDM objects on the smaller cc29 Xcelium workload; the official 1.86 source fetch was network-blocked and is availability evidence only. No automatic Surelog/UHDM fallback is justified.

dependency_model.validated_platform: CPython 3.11 Linux x86_64 manylinux wheel only
dependency_model.unsupported_platform_policy: structured optional-dependency blocker; no global install, silent source build, or bundled fallback

cold_frontend_worker_model.default_admission: one active cold build per server until Phase 1 adds memory-aware single-flight/resource admission
cold_frontend_worker_model.reason: The 2s timeout test reaped the worker without residue, native crash containment is required, and OpenTitan peaks near 2.14 GiB RSS per worker.

known_limitations: The full OpenTitan chip workload has 65 stable effective Slang errors: unresolved bind/hierarchical paths, procedural-force/runtime assertion constructs, Cadence UVM extension hooks, and UVM sequence type conversions. The result remains blocked even though all annotated hierarchy/file-line oracles match.

Native DPI implementations and simulator runtime system tasks are outside HDL connectivity; encrypted payloads or missing simulator-provided source libraries are explicit blockers, never silent fallback.
Aggregate frontend visitor counts can vary with native specialization traversal and are reported benchmark facts, not cache/connectivity identity.
phase_1_acceptance_items: Implement and validate Connectivity IR edge semantics for named/positional ports, slice/concat bit mapping, continuous/procedural drivers, and sequential dependencies.
Measure persistent-worker warm behavior, cache artifact size, storage-cold build, cancellation during projection, and single-flight only after the Phase 1 worker/cache design exists.
Keep explicit coverage/inconclusive receipts for unsupported bind, force, protected-source, DPI, and simulator-extension regions; do not call partial OpenTitan elaboration production-accurate.

evidence.method: line-numbered inspection of the exact FuseSoC work tree compiled by Xcelium

evidence.invocation: env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/traceweave-phase0b-opentitan-xdg PATH=/tmp/traceweave-phase0b-opentitan-tools/bin:/tools/cadence/XCELIUM2603/tools/bin/64bit:/tools/cadence/XCELIUM2603/tools/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin /tmp/traceweave-phase0b-opentitan-tools/bin/python util/dvsim/dvsim.py hw/top_earlgrey/dv/chip_sim_cfg.hjson --tool xcelium --scratch-root /tmp/traceweave-phase0b-opentitan-dvsim --branch phase0b-cold --local --max-parallel 1 --build-only --items chip_sw_uart_smoketest --print-interval 10 --build-timeout-mins 15 --build-opts=-L/tmp/traceweave-phase0b-opentitan-lib
evidence.count_comparison_policy: Reference facts only: Xcelium report categories and pyslang visitor categories are not definitionally identical, so exact count equality is not asserted.

fsdb_hierarchy.blocker: The selected official OpenTitan run was build-only and produced no waveform; FSDB hierarchy/path naming was already checked on the cc29 real Xcelium workload.

kdb_npi.blocker: No KDB accompanies the OpenTitan Xcelium build; NPI remains a development oracle only and is not a frontend or automated-test dependency.
